# Wire operations

The closed operation set: 64 operations. The wire name is each op's serde identifier; its request and response payload schemas live under `contracts/dli-worker/schemas/`. Summary is `Op::summary()` — the same tool-selection text an agent reads over MCP; Added in is `Op::introduced_in()` — the earliest accepted contract version the op is advertised at. The batch `dli.*` family and the `author.*` authoring-seam tools are one closed set.
